description: This file is a shell script used for testing the handling of SVN repositories with empty symlinks in a Git-SVN integration workflow. It loads a dump of an SVN repository, clones it using git svn, and performs various checks on symlink behavior under different configuration settings.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes the provided command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Asserts that the given file is empty.
